findings.kind: existing related conditional finding; selected current source witness
findings.trace: For an otherwise self-consistent tile, a 1-by-2 entry and local coordinate (1,0) flatten to index 1 and can return the (0,1) cell. The selected 95e assessment and reconstructed q120 already describe this first operation; this is not an executed package.
findings.historical_relationship: Reconstructed 059 q120 and f2c ledger 411 record the same first contract; preserve their own revision and null reader/path attribution. No new unique historical count or checkpoint 3821 recovery is asserted.
findings.connected_repair: Decide how a currently admitted undersized selected entry should be represented; prevent cross-row substitution. Review guard position relative to chunk decoding and downstream handling of missing versus error.
findings.acceptance: No out-of-extent local x/y returns another cell; meaningful higher-level validation should cover full/interior/final-edge chunks, missing/outside behavior and integrity/discriminant error precedence under the chosen policy.
findings.discovery: bounded first operation corroborated; crop, full geometry, all supported ingress and aliases remain open

findings.trace: Finite ordered bounds and a matching i16::MAX south tile can lead public cell lookup to evaluate south + 1 outside i16 range. Checked tactical origins and fixed transects differ from an API that accepts finite arbitrary offsets. Actual supported extreme input remains unproved.
findings.historical_relationship: Related by geographic bounds to f2c ledger 417, which instead traces the builder and i16::MIN tile-label arithmetic; equivalence is not established.
findings.connected_repair: Determine supported geographic contract and safe lookup arithmetic separately from chunk-axis checking.
findings.acceptance: Valid geographic edges retain intended mapping and invalid/extreme inputs do not overflow; exact policy remains open.
findings.discovery: bounded conditional source case; supported reach, policy and aliases remain open

findings.trace: A digest-consistent decoded canopy byte 101 passes the selected chunk checks; the builder instead maps source values above 100 to zero. Dispatcher conversion produces 10100 basis points and a later tactical grid validator rejects fields above 10000, if the selected path and prerequisites are reached.
findings.historical_relationship: A finite literal canopy search of selected f2c ledger entries found no match; this is not global alias or novelty proof and no historical count is claimed.
findings.connected_repair: Determine the authoritative byte contract and relevant ingestion and consumer semantics before selecting a change.
findings.acceptance: Admitted native cover and downstream units agree on the chosen bound, without weakening existing integrity checks.
findings.discovery: bounded conditional source case; byte policy, real packages, reach and aliases remain open

cross_lens_questions: Routing maps None to water and propagates Err; tactical required samples reject missing while optional peaks skip None but propagate errors. Regional capture retains holes. Strategic forage suppresses neighbor errors and absence but not center errors. Cultivation relief and road inference have separate error-erasure operations.

Reconstructed q128 and f2c ledger 441 concern relief-sample error handling; q130 and f2c ledger 442 concern road-plan omission. Ledger 441 also relates q283, whose recorded first operation is separate worker/CLI error formatting. Do not treat q128 and q283 as automatic aliases.
Cropped or undersized chunks, integral east/north boundary ownership, supported geographic limits, canopy byte policy and error precedence require decisions.
The surface enum and native byte decoder agree today; their independent numeric mappings are a future-change hazard, not a demonstrated current mismatch.
Coordinate, elevation and digest owner reuse requires separate policy, unit, wire and admission-timing review; it is not an observed wrong value by itself.

Selected same-file blob identity does not transfer historical reader credit or prove whole-tree identity. The selected pr-working source rows of q120, q128 and q130 retain null revision, path and named reader fields. Separately, q283 records revision 6533e444fa37552927070cc8d8190907fd3b413e, Git path crates/adventuresim-world-import/src/bin/build-strategic-map.rs, and reader Subagent /root/lens12_frontier personal prospective bounded untruncated read; preserve that distinct credit.
